title: Edit: walls 3 mm
prompt: Make the walls 3 mm thick (the shell feature's thickness); keep the fillet features.

hidden_tests.description: Evaluates cleanly and every body is a valid closed solid
One parameter changed (wall), no feature touched
No feature was edited, added or removed
Every reference (fillet edges, shell faces, hole face) still designates the same entities as before the edit (same keys), resolved exactly
The R4 corner fillets are still there
The Ø8 cable hole is still there, in the middle of the +X end

notes: Construction: walls, fillet_kept read the shell and fillet features the prompt asks for (no geometry equivalent in the report), so a correct part built otherwise fails only those tests.
